name: puregit
description: 纯粹的 GitHub 站点库浏览站点：React + shadcn/ui 前端 + Cloudflare Pages Worker (OAuth2 + CLI git 镜像代理)

scripts.format: oxfmt web/src worker/src worker/test scripts web/test
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check web/src worker/src worker/test scripts web/test
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter worker deploy
scripts.update:all: pnpm -r up && pnpm audit --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --audit-level high
